bio: Hello! My name is Segun Omole (he/him/his). I grew up in Nigeria and spent my early adult years (thus far) in the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, China, and the US! I double-majored in Political Science and Legal Studies in my undergraduate program and studied Global Affairs for my first post-graduate program. I am currently enrolled at Harvard Law. I am an avid music lover and anime watcher. I am also a badminton amateur, but a fanatic, nonetheless. In my nerdier times, I am keen on law, technology policy, macroeconomics, and African business and development. If any of those things appeal to you, or you’d like to connect over anything else in my bio or beyond, please reach out! I am an open book and always eager to make a new friend.
